objective: Certificar en READ_ONLY el cierre final de Gate13B posterior al R2B-RERUN-R2 integrado con PASS. Confirmar que el E2E quedó integrado, tests pasaron, SOC-00001 volvió a baseline, cero residuos UAT13B, FKs integras y no hubo cambios adicionales ni Produccion. No repetir UAT ni mutar codigo/datos.

queries.name: final_candidate
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS UnidadNegocioID,NumeroSocio,PersonaID,ClienteCRMID FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C');

queries.name: final_residual_personas
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona WHERE RFC LIKE N'UAT13B%';

queries.name: final_residual_bottles
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas WHERE ProductoNombre LIKE N'UAT13B-%' OR ProductoCodigo LIKE N'UAT13B-%';

queries.name: final_residual_movements
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos WHERE Observaciones LIKE N'UAT13B-%' OR MotivoMovimiento LIKE N'CAVAS-GATE13B-E2E-CONTROLLED-UAT-R2B-RERUN-%';

queries.name: final_residual_cargos
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos WHERE ConceptoCargo LIKE N'%UAT13B-%';

queries.name: final_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C')) AS botellas,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C')) AS movimientos,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C')) AS cargos;

queries.name: final_fk
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS child_table,name,is_disabled,is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE parent_object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos')) ORDER BY child_table,name;

constraints: Fail closed if any UAT13B residue remains
